_comment: Filesystem space and inodes. Linux reads /proc/self/mountinfo and statvfs; macOS reads getmntinfo. Pseudo filesystems, bind mounts and read-only mounts are hidden because none of them can fill.
_refresh_comment: Seconds between samples. Minimum 0.5. -n SECONDS on the command line overrides this for one run.
_hide_mounts_comment: Mount points to hide. An entry is an exact path, or a prefix of every mount under it when it ends in /. The entry / hides only the root mount; a prefix of / would hide every absolute path.
_hide_devices_comment: Whole-disk names to hide, matched exactly. An idle disk with no reads and no writes since boot is already hidden until v is pressed; this list hides a disk whether or not it is idle.
_warn_percent_comment: Percent used at which the bar starts to leave green. At and below this the bar stays quiet.
_alert_percent_comment: Percent used at which the bar is fully hot. Between warn_percent and this it climbs in a straight line.
_window_days_comment: How many days of this widget's own samples the FULL IN column and the filesystem trace start from. 7, 14 or 30. w on the pane cycles the same three for this session and does not write the choice back.
